p: words of Jeremiah the son of: That is, the sermons and prophecies.
Hilkiah: Who is thought to be he that found the book of the law under king Josiah, 2Ki 22:8.
Anathoth in the land of Benjamin: This was a city about three miles from Jerusalem and belonged to the priests, the sons of Aaron, Jos 21:18.
word of the LORD came in: This is spoken to confirm his calling and office, as he did not presume of himself to preach and prophecy, but was called to it by God.
son of Josiah king of Judah: Meaning the nephew of Josiah: for Jehoahaz was his father, who reigned but three months, and therefore is not mentioned, nor is Jehoiakim that reigned no longer.
month: Of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, who was also called Mattaniah, and at this time the Jews were carried away into Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar.
formed thee in the womb I: The scripture uses this manner of speech to declare that God has appointed his minsters to their offices before they were born, as in Isa 49:1, Ga 1:15.
nations: For Jeremiah did not only prophecy against the Jews, but also against the Egyptians, Babylonians, Moabites and other nations.

Ah: Considering the great judgments of God which according to his threatening would come on the world, he was moved with a certain compassion on the one hand to pity them that would thus perish, and on the other hand by the infirmity of man's nature, knowing how hard a thing it was to enterprise such a charge, as in Isa 6:11, Ex 3:21,4:1.
touched my mouth: Which declares that God makes them meet and assures them, whom he calls to set forth his glory, giving them all means necessary for the same, Ex 4:12, Isa 6:7.

nations and over the kingdoms: He shows what is the authority of God's true ministers, who by his word have power to bear down whatever lifts itself up against God: and to plant and assure the humble and such as give themselves to the obedience of God's word, 2Co 10:4,5, He 4:12, and these are the keys which Christ has left to loose and bind, Mt 18:18.

rod of an almond tree: He joins the sign with the word, for a more ample confirmation: signifying by the rod of the almond tree, which first buds, the hasty coming of the Babylonians against the Jews.
pot: Signifying that the Chaldeans and Assyrians would be as a pot to seethe the Jews who boiled in their pleasures and lust.
north an evil shall break forth: Syria and Assyria were northward in respect to Jerusalem, which was the Chaldeans dominion.
judgments against them concerning all their: I will give them charge and power to execute my vengeance against the idolaters who have forsaken me for their idols.
confound thee before them: Which declares that God's vengeance is prepared against them who do not execute their duty faithfully, either for fear of man, or for any other reason, 1Co 9:16.

iron pillar: Signifying on the one hand that the more that Satan and the world rage against God's ministers, the more present will he be to help them, Jos 1:5, He 13:5 and on the other hand, that they are utterly unfit to serve God in his Church, who are afraid and do not resist wickedness, whatever danger depend on it, Isa 50:7, Eze 3:8.
